note: The list is empty. Every failure the suite recorded when it was written has been fixed, and each entry came off as its fix landed. A known failure prints on every run and does not fail the run. A known failure that starts passing DOES fail the run, so a fix is never merged without its entry coming off this list. An entry matches a case id exactly through `case`, or by a regular expression through `match` when one finding shows up under several case ids.
